description: This file defines a custom exception class `XliffFileProcessFailedException` within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin, used for handling specific errors related to XLIFF file processing.

classes.name: XliffFileProcessFailedException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to XLIFF file processing failures.

methods.name: validationFailed
methods.description: Creates an exception instance indicating the XLIFF file validation failed.

methods.name: emptyFile
methods.description: Creates an exception instance indicating the XLIFF file is empty.

methods.name: missingTargetLanguage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance indicating the XLIFF file is missing the target language attribute.

methods.name: invalidTargetLanguage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance indicating the target language does not match the expected language.
